data: Is the learning rate value of the blue line 6 when it is at its peak?

The caption states that the maximum value of w(t) is 10. The learning rate is shown on the right graph, which has a y-axis range of 0 to 6 × 10^-5. The blue line in the right graph reaches its peak at approximately 6 × 10^-5, not 6. Therefore, the learning rate value of the blue line is not 6 when it is at its peak.
